exposure: mode of delivery after cesarean section
cohort: 515 women with one prior cesarean section without contraindications for a trial of labor from 17 Dutch hospitals in 2010
finding: Large practice variation exists in elective repeat cesarean section and VBAC rates, with over 85% of this variation not explained by patient risk factors, suggesting inconsistency in implementing contemporary guidelines.
mod_finding: 72% of women who had a trial of labor after a previous cesarean section delivered vaginally.
